question: In the carbide slag-assisted steam gasification of sewage sludge at 700 °C, by what percentage did the H2 yield rise when Ca/C went from 0 to 0.75?
rendered:
According to the document, at 700 °C, the H2 yield rose from 207.40 mL g−1 at Ca/C = 0 to 332.85 mL g−1 at Ca/C = 0.75.

To find the percentage rise, we can calculate:

((332.85 - 207.40) / 207.40) * 100%
= (125.45 / 207.40) * 100%
= 0.604 * 100%
= 60.4%

So the H2 yield rose by 60.4% when Ca/C went from 0 to 0.75.
